content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Investigator Smith. With whom am I speaking?
Hello, this is Rajesh Kumar. I received a voicemail asking me to call about my taxes. Is there a problem?

Thank you, Mr. Kumar. Yes, the IRS audit division flagged your 2021 and 2022 tax filings for discrepancies. I need to verify your identity first. Can you confirm your date of birth and current address?
Yes, my date of birth is January 14, 1982, and my address is 2017 Oakmont Drive, Houston.
Alright, please hold while I pull up your file... Okay, according to our system, there is an outstanding tax debt of $5,382 under your name, with suspected misreporting. Are you aware of this?
No, I had no idea. I had my accountant file my taxes. What does this mean?

It means the IRS has detected underreported income. This is classified as tax fraud under section 7201. At this point, a warrant for your arrest has been issued and your professional license is at risk of suspension.
Arrest? Suspended license? Please, I cannot lose my job. What am I supposed to do?
If you fail to resolve this immediately, federal officers will be dispatched to your residence within the next 90 minutes. Additionally, your bank accounts and assets will be frozen.
No, please, I have a family. I didn't mean to break any law. Is there anything I can do to fix this?
As a courtesy, the IRS does allow for an out-of-court settlement if you comply before the legal action is finalized. Are you prepared to make a payment to clear the charges?
Yes, yes, I want to settle. What do I need to do?
Good. For cases flagged as urgent, payment must be made using government-approved digital vouchers. Do you have access to a local Walgreens or CVS pharmacy?
Yes, there is a Walgreens about five minutes away.

Go there right now and purchase five Apple Gift Cards, each for $500. Once you have the cards, remain on this call and read me the numbers on the back. This will register your payment in the IRS system and halt enforcement.
Apple Gift Cards? Are you sure? That doesn't sound like how the IRS works.
Mr. Kumar, this is a confidential compliance protocol. If you doubt the process and fail to act, the warrant will be executed and your license revoked. Do you want to risk jail and deportation?
No, no, I don't. I just want this resolved. I'll go buy the cards. Should I call back?
Stay on the line. As soon as you have the cards, give me the codes. This is the only way to suspend the arrest warrant immediately.
Okay, I'm leaving now. It will take me about ten minutes to get back.
That's fine. Do not disconnect or speak with anyone about this case. If the line is cut, the case will be escalated and enforcement will proceed.
Alright. I'm going as fast as I can. Please don't let them arrest me.
Cooperate fully and you will be protected. Once you have the gift cards, confirm you are ready to read the numbers.
I've got the cards. Should I read the codes now?
Read each gift card number and activation code, one at a time, slowly and clearly.
Okay, the first card is 1234 5678 9012 3456, code 7890.
Continue with the next four codes.
Go on, two more.
Thank you. I am processing your payment now. Stay on the line for confirmation.
